guide.summary: Lets a bacterium and an alga pair up and share food.
guide.biology: In real ponds some bacteria live right beside algae, and the two can trade materials.
guide.rules: Costs 0.02 energy per second while carried. A free, active Sprinter, Crossfeeder, Crumbsmith or Lantern carrier that stays within 0.5 cells of a free, active Sunbead or Shadeleaf carrier for 5 seconds, both with at least 20 energy, may bond for 3 energy each. Each has at most one partner. Partners stop swimming, pay another 0.05 energy per second each and feed as usual. A partner above 1.20 times its starting body sends up to 0.005 × starting body per second of carbon to a partner below that, paying 1 energy per carbon. The bond breaks on death, capture, division or resting, when pulled more than 0.75 cells apart or split by a new barrier, or when either stays below 15 energy for 10 seconds; then 10 seconds must pass before a new bond. Newborns start unbonded. No bonds during Settler stages.
guide.example: Put bonding Crumbsmiths beside bonding Sunbeads in a dish with starch and light, and compare pairs with singles.
